svg.title: Five interfaces cover how an agent calls a tool, and code execution is the one built for multi-step work.
svg.desc: JSON tool calling handles small, well-scoped toolsets with typed request and response. MCP shares discovery and transport across vendors. Skills load instructions on demand while the model still calls existing tools. CLI and shell tools use commands the model already knows. Code execution is highlighted: one script runs loops and conditionals in a sandbox and returns only a summary.
